 Our Vision!
 Founded in 2006 with 650+ engineers & global presence (8 delivery centers in Europe & North America) we strive to become a leading East-European technology partner for growing organizations in need of digital transformation of their products and services!
 What You’ll Do
You will work closely with Google’s Wear OS Platform Teams to architect and deliver solutions across SysUI, Wear Compose Libraries, WearServices, and cross-device APIs — driving measurable improvements in reliability, resource efficiency, and codebase maintainability.
Identify and fix code issues in the Wear Platform, including security patches and Board Support Package (BSP) updates
Reduce platform technical debt through targeted refactoring of the WearServices codebase for maintainability and cleanliness
Create automated performance tests for Wear OS components (SysUI, Wear Compose Libraries) to monitor RAM usage, jank, and battery consumption
Propose and implement architectural changes to drive resource reduction
Fix bugs in Home / Wear Core Services / WearServices, including user-facing “papercut” issues in notification systems
Write API coverage tests and performance benchmark infrastructure for cross-device journeys and initialization latency
Collaborate with Google engineers to validate implementations and resolve blockers with dependent teams
Produce clear technical documentation for architectural decisions, performance findings, and remediation actions
 What You Need To Be Successful
8+ years of experience in Android development
Android Platform architecture and Board Support Packages (BSPs)
Experience with security patching and low-level system debugging on Android
Proficiency in Android performance profiling tools for memory, battery, and frame drop analysis
Android Services and cross-device APIs
Knowledge of SysUI and AndroidX Wear Compose Libraries
Proven ability to analyze complex performance metrics and architect solutions for resource reduction
Experience refactoring legacy codebases for cleanliness and long-term maintainability
Familiarity with Buganizer or equivalent issue tracking systems for structured analysis and validation
Proficiency in Kotlin and Java (Android); Python is a plus
Ability to write clear, structured technical documentation
 Nice to have
Experience with Wear OS internals or system-level Wear OS components
Familiarity with CTS (Compatibility Test Suite) or WTS (Wear Test Suite) compliance processes
Experience working on large-scale, multi-team Android platform projects
Prior involvement in notification system architecture or user-experience reliability work
Hands-on experience with Mobly or other Android test automation frameworks
 What We Offer You To Be Successful
Flexible working environment, ability to work remotely or in a hybrid model, depending on your project requirements.
Work with worldwide technology leaders - We partner and deliver technology to industry giants like Intel, NXP, Panasonic, Visteon, Carrefour, Windriver, Kardex, METRO Digital, and many others.

We have premium referral bonus for each successful recommendation you make - (500-1500 EUR NET based on seniority)
